NOTE: The walkdown to D7 can either be played
with the actual chords (C-Em-A-G-D7) or the
notes (C-B-A-G-Gb). Tony Rice leans more towards
the notes in the actual record.

Capo: 3rd Fret


[Intro]

[ch]C[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch]  [ch]Am[/ch]  [ch]Em[/ch]  [ch]F[/ch]  [ch]C[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch]  [ch]C[/ch]


[Verse 1]

[tab][ch]C[/ch]                 [ch]G[/ch]               [ch]Am[/ch]          [ch]Em[/ch]
Have you seen the old man, in the closed-down market[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]              [ch]C[/ch]                [ch]F[/ch]        [ch]G[/ch]
Kicking up the papers, with his worn-out shoes?[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]               [ch]G[/ch]                 [ch]Am[/ch]            [ch]Em[/ch]
In his eyes you see no pride, and there loosely at his side[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]           [ch]C[/ch]              [ch]G[/ch]           [ch]C[/ch]
Yesterday's paper, telling yesterday's news[/tab]


[Chorus 1]

[tab]   [ch]F[/ch]           [ch]C[/ch]
So how can you tell me, that you're mourning[/tab]
[tab][ch]D7[/ch]                                     [ch]G[/ch]
And you say for you that the sun don't shine?[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]               [ch]G[/ch]
Let me take you by the hand[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]Am[/ch]                   [ch]Em[/ch]
And lead you through the streets of London[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]             [ch]C[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]                    [ch]C[/ch]
I'll show you something, to make you change your mind[/tab]


[Verse 2]

[tab][ch]C[/ch]                 [ch]G[/ch]            [ch]Am[/ch]                   [ch]Em[/ch]
Have you seen the old gal, who walks the streets of London[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]           [ch]C[/ch]             [ch]F[/ch]          [ch]G[/ch]
Dirt in her hair, and her clothes in rags?[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                 [ch]G[/ch]            [ch]Am[/ch]                  [ch]Em[/ch]
She's no time for talking, she just keeps right on walking[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]            [ch]C[/ch]            [ch]G[/ch]       [ch]C[/ch]
Carrying her home, in two carrier bags[/tab]


[Chorus 2]

[tab]   [ch]F[/ch]           [ch]C[/ch]

[tab][ch]D7[/ch]                                     [ch]G[/ch]

[tab][ch]F[/ch]             [ch]C[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]                    [ch]C[/ch]
I'll show you something, to make you change your mind[/tab]


[Interlude]

[ch]C[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch]  [ch]Am[/ch]  [ch]Em[/ch]  [ch]F[/ch]  [ch]C[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch]  [ch]C[/ch]


[Verse 3]

[tab]    [ch]C[/ch]                [ch]G[/ch]          [ch]Am[/ch]            [ch]Em[/ch]
And in the all-night cafe, at a quarter past eleven[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]        [ch]C[/ch]           [ch]F[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]
Same old man sitting there, on his own[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]              [ch]G[/ch]               [ch]Am[/ch]         [ch]Em[/ch]
Looking at the world, over the rim of his tea-cup[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]F[/ch]                 [ch]C[/ch]            [ch]G[/ch]             [ch]C[/ch]
And each tea lasts an hour, and he wanders home alone[/tab]


[Chorus 3]

[tab]   [ch]F[/ch]           [ch]C[/ch]

[Verse 4]

[tab]    [ch]C[/ch]                 [ch]G[/ch]          [ch]Am[/ch]                [ch]Em[/ch]
And have you seen the old man outside the seamens' mission[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]             [ch]C[/ch]              [ch]F[/ch]               [ch]G[/ch]
Memory fading with the medal-ribbon that he wears[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]C[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]              [ch]Am[/ch]             [ch]Em[/ch]
And in the winter city, the rain cries a little pity[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]F[/ch]                  [ch]C[/ch]          [ch]G[/ch]                  [ch]C[/ch]
For one more forgotten hero, in a world that doesn't care[/tab]
